name: instagram-mcp-ai
description: MCP server for the Instagram Platform (Meta Graph API) — professional-account tools.

IG_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: Instagram access token
IG_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Long-lived access token for the Instagram professional account. This is the only token variable the server reads, and it is the same variable for both auth paths — Instagram Login and Facebook Login. Get one with `npx instagram-mcp-ai login` (see docs/plugin-install.md). Stored in the OS keychain, never in settings.json.
